An ancient '''fleet''' of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] orbited the [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Denbalen]], with the shattered vessels forming a debris field around the world. The starships' origin and the cause of their destruction were a mystery to archaeologists during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].
